subject: Money
title: Tax as Redistribution
description: Learn Tax as Redistribution in one minute.

hook.text: Sweden taxes up to 52% of income. The U.S. top rate is 37%. Both countries function, differently.

buildup.text: Progressive taxation means the rich pay a higher percentage. The idea dates back to Adam Smith in 1776.

discovery.text: Redistribution funds healthcare, education, and safety nets. It reduces the gap between rich and poor.

twist.text: Critics argue redistribution kills incentive. Why earn more if government takes half?

climax.text: Every society chooses a balance between equality and incentive. Tax rates reflect that choice.

punchline.text: Tax policy is philosophy with a deadline.

quiz.question: What does progressive taxation mean?
options: Higher earners pay a higher percentage
